title: Rav Chanan son of Rav Yitzchak
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In the reading Hyman attributes to [the Rif](https://www.sefaria.org/Rif_Pesachim.9a.2) and Dikdukei Soferim, Rav Chanan son of Rav Yitzchak said in the name of Rav Chiyya bar Ashi, who said in the name of Shmuel. Hyman’s text of [Pesachim 30b](https://www.sefaria.org/Pesachim.30b.10) reads Rava bar Abba as the first transmitter.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The heading supplies the transmitter whose report begins “Rav Chiyya bar Ashi said that Shmuel said.” The William Davidson digital text of Pesachim 30b has Rava bar Abba as that transmitter. Hyman reports Chanan son of Rav Yitzchak for the Rif/Dikdukei Soferim reading; these alternatives are not merged.

The linked Rif text opens with Rav Chanan son of Rav Yitzchak. The linked Gemara has Rava bar Abba in that place. Both then name Rav Chiyya bar Ashi transmitting in the name of Shmuel. Hyman also attributes the Chanan reading to Dikdukei Soferim, whose exact apparatus is uncollated here.
